name: hamronepal
description: हाम्रो नेपाल - Nepali news portal (web, api, shared). The Expo app in apps/mobile is installed separately.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
